seoTitle: Spot-On Caricature For Events | I Do Art Studios
seoDescription: Spot-on caricature artist in Lagos, Nigeria. Our hilarious live caricatures have been enjoyed at corporate events and private parties across Nigeria and internationally — book Nigeria's premier live caricature entertainment service.
heading: Spot-On Caricature For Events
intro: Nigeria's premier live caricature and event entertainment service, pioneered by Owolabi (Mr. Caricature) through I Do Art Studios.

sections.title: Pioneer Artist
sections.body: Founded by Owolabi, a self-taught digital and traditional caricaturist and member of the International Society of Caricature Artists (ISCA).

sections.title: Live Entertainment
sections.body: Fast, funny, and accurate live sketching for corporate parties, weddings, and VIP gatherings in Lagos and at international venues.

sections.title: Keepsakes
sections.body: Guests receive instant digital or physical cartoon portraits as memorable event takeaways.
